EC1: [NOT] not a regular user [AND] of e-cigarettes
EC2: pregnant or lactating (only excluded from imaging study)
EC5: unable to lie flat on the scanner for extended periods of time
EC6: unstable medical condition like heart disease [OR], uncontrolled hypertension [OR], thyroid disease [OR], diabetes [OR], renal [OR] or liver impairment [OR], or glaucoma
EC7: prostatic hypertrophy [OR], stroke [OR], or ulcer in past year
EC8: psychiatric conditions such as schizophrenia [OR], adult ADHD [OR], or bipolar disorder
EC9: current or regular use of psychiatric medications such as tranquilizers [OR], antipsychotics [OR], and/or antidepressants
EC10: use of medications that are inducers of CYP2A6 (a nicotine metabolizing enzyme) such as rifampicin [OR], dexamethasone [OR], phenobarbital [OR], and other anti-convulsant drugs
EC12: current use of smokeless tobacco [OR], tobacco cigarettes (5 and fewer a day)
EC13: occasional use of pipes is permitted if subject abstains for the week prior to the study
